output.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM marts.fct_order_lines l JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1
output.explanation: Joins order lines to orders (for is_revenue and order_date) and products. Filters to completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed in 2025, sums quantity per product, and returns the product with the highest total. If two products tie on units, only one is returned; the query does not show ties.
